title: Fix pager off-by-one
instruction: `pageItems` in lib/pager.js returns the wrong slice of items. Pages are 1-based: page 1 returns the first `pageSize` items, page 2 the next `pageSize`, and so on. Requesting a page beyond the last page returns an empty array. Fix the function so it follows that contract. Run `node main.js` to see the demo output.
